scope: index.html site-introduction static public landing, navigation, FAQ, provenance, capability boundaries, and homepage-experience.js interactive preview copy; excludes learning workspace, Core lessons, and readable exports

hero-intro.source: 第一次接觸圍棋也可以開始。先在右側合成局面做一個可逆選擇；它不會寫入課程紀錄，也不會被當成正式作答。
hero-intro.text: New to Go? Start with the example on the right. Reveal what follows from a possible move, then reset it. This synthetic preview does not count as a course answer or update your progress.

trust-first-response.text: First choice and corrections stay separate

preview-question.source: 哪裡能把兩塊空間真正分開？
preview-question.text: Where could Black try to separate these two spaces?

preview-warning.source: 金色是目前選點，不代表正確。
preview-warning.text: The gold marker shows a possible choice, not a confirmed answer.

preview-consequence.source: 兩塊空間仍共用同一個破壞點
preview-consequence.text: The two spaces still share a point where White can break in

preview-synthetic.source: 合成示範，不寫入 learner evidence、分數或課程進度。
preview-synthetic.text: Illustrative position only. It does not change your learning record, score or course progress.

entry-title.source: 第一次學圍棋，和已有基礎的人，不需要走同一條路。
entry-title.text: Start with the Go skills you already have

entry-explainer.source: 你可以依照現在的理解與目標，選擇一個起點。三個入口各自連到既有課程內容；它們不是棋力分級，也不保證學習結果。
entry-explainer.text: Choose a starting point based on what you want to practise. These paths link to existing lessons; they are not rank levels or promises of improvement.

entry-beginner-detail.source: 從氣、提子、連接與切斷開始
entry-beginner-detail.text: Learn liberties, captures, connections and cuts

entry-beginner-copy.source: 用最小的棋盤，學會圍棋最核心的規則與棋形。適合完全新手，或想重新打好基礎的你。
entry-beginner-copy.text: Use a small board to learn the rules and recognise basic shapes. Suitable if you are completely new to Go or returning to the basics.

entry-local-copy.source: 學會從局部棋形中，判斷哪一方有利、哪裡有風險，逐步培養計算與閱讀棋形的能力。
entry-local-copy.text: Look at a local position, identify risks for each side and practise reading the next few moves.

entry-wholeboard.text: Connect local decisions to the whole board

entry-wholeboard-copy.source: 在 9 路棋局中，練習全盤觀察、形勢判斷與策略選擇，將所學應用到完整對局。
entry-wholeboard-copy.text: Use 9×9 games to practise whole-board awareness, judgement and decisions in a complete game.

catalog-count.source: 目前課程：15 單元 · 19 課 · 106 題。這些數字只描述內容量，不代表學習成效或棋力。
catalog-count.text: Current catalogue: 15 units, 19 lessons and 106 Core items. These numbers describe content, not measured learning gains or playing rank.

method-title.source: 不是看做了幾題，而是看隔一段時間後還能不能自己做。
method-title.text: Can you make the decision again later, without a hint?

method-caveat.source: 這四步是本站採用的練習流程，不是對個人學習效果的保證；可用它安排觀察、作答、回看與換形再判。
method-caveat.text: These four steps organise practice and later checks. They do not guarantee that anyone has learned a skill.

preview-board-description.source: 切換後會保留黑棋第一次選點，紅色外圈標示白棋可由右側進入的位置，並顯示可觀察後果與規則理由。這不是正式題目。
preview-board-description.text: Reveal a possible Black move. The original choice stays visible while a red ring shows where White can enter from the right. This is an illustration, not a scored question.

preview-response-detail.source: 紅色外圈標示白棋可由右側進入的位置；回到內部空點重新計算。
preview-response-detail.text: The red ring marks a point where White can enter from the right. Look again at the empty intersections inside.

preview-method-aria.text: Four steps in a practice cycle

preview-method-first-description.text: Choose a move before seeing the answer

preview-method-feedback-description.text: Look again for the important board clues

preview-method-delay-description.text: Try to recall the idea after a delay

preview-method-transfer-description.text: Make a fresh decision in an unfamiliar position

path-beginner-status.source: 適合完全零基礎，從第一口氣開始。
path-beginner-status.text: Start with your first liberty. No prior Go knowledge needed.

path-local-detail.source: 看懂棋形，做出正確選擇
path-local-detail.text: Read the shape before choosing a move

path-global-detail.source: 從局部走向全局的思考
path-global-detail.text: Bring local reading to a full game

catalog-summary-detail.source: 查看核心課程與進階訓練，依自己的需要選擇。
catalog-summary-detail.text: Browse Core lessons and advanced practice, then choose where to begin.

catalog-core-detail.source: 從氣與提子開始，練習規則、局部讀棋與全局判斷。也可以在下方直接選擇單元。
catalog-core-detail.text: Learn liberties and captures first, then practise rules, reading local positions and whole-board decisions. You can also choose a unit below.

catalog-advanced-detail.source: 深化讀棋與手筋、中盤攻防、官子及全局判斷。這些內容目前作練習，不換算級位。
catalog-advanced-detail.text: Practise reading, tactics, fighting, endgame and whole-board judgement. These exercises do not establish a playing rank.

catalog-live-link.source: 想下完整一局？前往自由對弈與複盤
catalog-live-link.text: Want a complete game? Try free play and review

catalog-unit-heading.source: 核心課程：選一個單元開始

method-first-detail.source: 先思考再落子，培養獨立思考的習慣。
method-first-detail.text: Look at the board and choose a move before revealing feedback.

method-feedback-detail.source: 對照解析，再看關鍵點，知道自己為什麼錯、下次怎麼做。
method-feedback-detail.text: Compare your choice with the explanation and look for the crucial board clue.

method-delay-detail.source: 隔一段時間再試一次，留下可比較的作答紀錄。
method-delay-detail.text: Try again after a delay, so the responses can be compared.

method-transfer-detail.source: 換一個不同棋形，再檢查原本的判斷能否適用。
method-transfer-detail.text: Check whether the idea still works in a different Go position.

method-evidence-line.source: 不是只看完成題數，而是保留隔時與不同棋形中的可比較作答；這些紀錄本身不等於已證實的學習成效。
method-evidence-line.text: We keep comparable responses from later attempts and new positions. These records do not by themselves prove that learning improved.

method-current-tasks.source: 課程／練習／到期複習／延後再判／局面應用。這是任務類型，不是能力等級；上方四個動作則是在說明練習方法。
method-current-tasks.text: Course, practice, due review, delayed check and position application are task types, not skill ranks. The four steps above describe the practice process.

philosophy-title-2.source: 不只用做了幾題來衡量進步。
philosophy-title-2.text: we look for decisions that hold up later.

philosophy-detail.source: 做題只是練習的一部分。我們更關心：你能否看懂棋形、做出判斷，並在新的局面用上所學。
philosophy-detail.text: Finishing questions is only part of practice. We also want to check whether you can read a position, make a decision and apply the idea in a new setting.

philosophy-read-more.source: 想多認識圍棋？也可以從這裡延伸閱讀。
philosophy-read-more.text: Want to explore Go beyond the exercises? Start with these articles.

outcome-title-a.text: Begin with the decisions you can make,

outcome-title-b.source: 不先貼 K 級或段位。
outcome-title-b.text: not a kyu or dan label.

outcome-detail.source: 不確定自己的級位也沒關係。從你能理解的內容開始，再練習更複雜的棋形。
outcome-detail.text: You do not need to know your rank. Start with positions you understand, then move towards more complex ones.

outcome-not-rank.source: 完成課程不等同 15K、10K、5K 或某個段位；本站尚未做外部棋力對照與真人校準。
outcome-not-rank.text: Completing these lessons does not establish 15 kyu, 10 kyu, 5 kyu or a dan rank. External rank comparison and calibration with real learners have not been carried out.

faq-title.source: 開始前先知道這三件事
faq-title.text: Three things to know before you start

faq-rules-q.text: Do I need to know the rules?

faq-rules-a.source: 不用。第一課就是從棋子的氣與提子開始，核心進度目前保存在這台瀏覽器，不需要先建立帳號。
faq-rules-a.text: No. The first lesson introduces liberties and captures. Core progress is currently saved in this browser, with no account required.

faq-rank-q.source: 完成課程等於幾 K 或幾段？
faq-rank-q.text: Will finishing the course give me a kyu or dan rank?

faq-rank-a.source: 目前不能換算。本站尚未做外部棋力對照與真人校準，因此不把完成課程直接換成級位或段位。
faq-rank-a.text: No rank conversion is available. The course has not been calibrated against external playing ranks with learners.

faq-time-q.source: 這個課程需要每天練多久？
faq-time-q.text: How much time should I practise each day?

faq-time-a.source: 不要求每天固定時數。可以用短時間持續練習；重點是之後再回來做，並在新的棋形中重新判斷。
faq-time-a.text: There is no required daily duration. Short sessions are fine; return later and try the idea in a new shape.

research-summary.source: 完整來源、研究限制與目前驗證狀態
research-summary.text: Sources, research limitations and current verification

research-summary-detail.source: 想知道內容參考哪裡、哪些事情尚未驗證，再展開這裡。
research-summary-detail.text: Open this section to see what informed the course and what remains unverified.

research-method.source: 這四個動作是目前課程的練習設計方向；下方列出完整來源與研究限制。
research-method.text: These four actions describe the current practice design. The references and their limits are listed below.

research-status-caveat.source: 正式教學目前尚未開放：外部棋理審查、三位目標初學者的實際操作測試，以及真人無障礙抽查都還沒有完成。正式的新題評量目前停用，學習成效也還沒有足夠資料可以判定。進階訓練目前只作練習紀錄，不納入正式學習評量。
research-status-caveat.text: Formal teaching has not been opened. Independent Go-content review, hands-on sessions with three target beginners and human accessibility checks are still pending. Formal evaluation using new items is disabled; learning outcomes are not yet established. Advanced training remains practice, outside formal learning evaluation.

research-backup-caveat.source: 核心與實戰資料可由 Core 工具備份；獨立進階訓練則在進階頁另行匯出，兩邊不會假裝成同一份完整備份。
research-backup-caveat.text: Back up Core and live-game records using the Core tools. Advanced-training records have a separate export on the Advanced page; neither export represents a combined complete backup.

research-github-status.source: 最新狀態以 GitHub 原始碼庫中的
research-github-status.text: For the latest project status, consult the repository's

final-cta-detail.source: 不用圍棋經驗，也不需要先達到任何級位。
final-cta-detail.text: No Go experience or playing rank is required.

final-cta-detail-2.source: 從看見棋子如何互相影響開始，打下穩固的第一步。
final-cta-detail-2.text: Begin by seeing how stones affect each other on the board.

final-cta-footer.source: 從第一課，打開你的圍棋之路
final-cta-footer.text: Start your Go journey with lesson one

preview-live-after.source: 合成預覽已顯示可觀察後果；第一次選點仍留在棋盤上。
preview-live-after.text: The illustration now shows a possible consequence. The original choice remains visible on the board.

preview-live-before.source: 合成預覽已回到作答前；沒有寫入任何學習紀錄。
preview-live-before.text: The illustration is reset. Nothing was added to your learning record.
